notes: Newest first; limit is 1 to 500 (200 if left out). Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page; it is null on the last. Filters: folder (one folder's id; 404 not_found for a folder the caller doesn't see), kind, q, day. Without folder: every folder the caller sees. folder in a file is the id of the folder it lies in. from is the sender's name when they have an account, null for a PIN. width, height and duration_ms are null when unknown.
